articles.title: Someone was trying to sell Ondo Finance after founder Nathan Allman's death
articles.snippet: The company has vehemently denied that it was shopping for buyers. Allman’s estate declined to comment.

articles.title: Bitcoin just topped a key long-term moving average. Here's what it might mean
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s return above its one-year average excited chart watchers. AltcoinPro Research says the more important signal is whether it can stay above its 200-day average.

articles.title: European stablecoin issuer Qivalis sees transformation of global trade finance
articles.snippet: Jan-Oliver Sell, the CEO and founder of Qivalis, said the entire trade finance supply chain is moving into stablecoins.

articles.title: Cathie Wood's ARK teams with Securitize to tokenize venture fund with OpenAI, Anthropic stakes
articles.snippet: The ARK Venture Fund is bringing exposure to sought-after private tech companies onchain through Securitize, first on Ethereum then potentially expanding to other chains.

articles.title: EU's financial regulator to make AI and tokenization a supervisory priority in 2027
articles.snippet: European regulators will map how financial firms use the technologies in client-facing products and begin checks on the most affected businesses.
